name: my-17--grok-4-7
question: What is the capital gains tax rate on the disposal of unlisted shares acquired in 2024 or later in Malaysia?
answer:
In Malaysia, capital gains tax on disposal of unlisted shares acquired in 2024 or later depends on holding period (per Inland Revenue Board rules):
- Held 2 years or less: 30% of the gain.
- Held 2–5 years: 10% of the gain.
- Held more than 5 years: 0% (no tax).
The rate is not fixed but tiered by ownership duration. No changes apply specifically for 2024 acquisitions.
